name: Reckon402 ResearchAgent
description: Three sequential x402 paid calls to agent.reckon402.com/research. Each confirmed settlement writes a facilitator-signed ERC-8004 attestation on-chain and routes 10% of the payment into the SellingAgent's per-agent on-chain Escrow (87% seller / 3% facilitator-fee / 10% Escrow via the immutable Splitter). The Escrow holds those funds against future claims; a pluggable tier strategy reads the on-chain attestation count back and unlocks a larger releasedBps fraction as the count walks T0 → T1 → T2 → ... (thresholds [0,1,3,10,30,100,300,1000], release BPS [0,500,1500,3000,5000,7000,8500,10000]). Withdrawal gates on IdentityRegistry.ownerOf(agentId) == msg.sender, so accumulated funds follow the agent's NFT around an ownership transfer.

nodes.description: First settlement (0.01 USDC). Splitter routes 1000 atomic (10%) into the Escrow; Escrow.totalDeposited grows. The facilitator writes the first ERC-8004 NewFeedback event tagged ('payment','x402-settlement'). attestationCount walks 0 → 1; releasedBps walks 0 → 500 (T1).

Second settlement (0.01 USDC). Escrow.totalDeposited += 1000 atomic. Second ERC-8004 attestation written; attestationCount = 2 stays within T1 (releasedBps = 500). withdrawableNow = max(0, releasedAmount − totalWithdrawn) updates against the new totalDeposited.

Third settlement (0.01 USDC). Escrow.totalDeposited = 3000 atomic. Third ERC-8004 attestation written; attestationCount = 3 crosses the T2 threshold and releasedBps walks 500 → 1500. The seller's NFT-bound owner can call Escrow.withdrawAll() to claim the new tier's released slice.

config.log: Three settlements completed. Three facilitator-signed ERC-8004 attestations on-chain. Escrow.totalDeposited = 3000 atomic; attestationCount = 3 (T2); releasedBps walked 0 → 500 → 1500. The NFT-bound owner can claim the released slice via Escrow.withdrawAll(). Live state at https://app.reckon402.com/#/agent/seller11.reckon402-test.eth (rendered from Escrow.getStats() via eth_call).
